fixes.text: Each job spends 1.8 minutes on setup: cache dependencies and build once
Setup on the critical path: 3.0 min of setup in jobs that first wait on others; start it while they wait, and wait only for the step you need
Split @elementor/editor-props#.: it re-exports 80 modules to 13 packages, so an edit to any of them reaches all of those packages' checks; give each area its own entry, listed by name, not `export *`
68 cached tasks declare no inputs, such as @elementor/alpinejs#build: declare each one's inputs, so an edit it doesn't read keeps its cache
A chain of 15 tasks runs one after another on a cache miss: cut the `dependsOn` edges a task doesn't need
